description: Watercolor study of red flowers on thorny, leaf covered branches in glass vase. The vase of flowers is positioned slightly left of the center at the bottom of the paper. There are two primary branches of flowers, one that extends up, and one that bends up and towards the right side of the page. The background is done in a light tan and light gray green wash.
